literal_meaning: পঞ্চভূতের প্রাপ্তি (attaining the five elements: earth, water, fire, air, ether)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পঞ্চত্বপ্রাপ্তি সকলকে শোকাহত করে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His attainment of the five elements has saddened everyone.
Many soldiers met their death on the battlefield.
note: Derived from Sanskrit 'panchatva' referring to dissolution into the five elements in Hindu cosmology.
